books.title: 逆さ時計の魔女
books.titleKana: さかさどけいのまじょ
books.titleEn: The Witch of the Backward Clock
books.tagline: 十年動かなかった母の時計が、逆さに回り始めた。
books.taglineEn: Her mother's watch hadn't moved in ten years. Then it began to run backwards.

characters.name: セラ
characters.desc: 16. Scholarship student in the Academy's Mechanics course, granddaughter of a lower-ring clockmaker. Her mother vanished ten years ago and left a watch that has never run.
characters.register: Casual feminine-neutral: あたし, plain forms, sentence-final の/よ/ね, contractions (〜てる, 〜ちゃう, わかんない).

characters.name: ニコ
characters.desc: Sera's classmate and best friend. Eldest of six, son of a canal boatman, building a flying machine in a rented shed with parts of dubious origin.
characters.register: 関西弁 (Kansai dialect): や for だ, 〜へん for 〜ない, 〜ねん/〜やん endings, ほんま, あかん, 自分 for 'you'. In fiction, the voice of merchants, comedians and big-hearted friends.

characters.name: ヴィオラ
characters.desc: Top first-year of the Chronomancy course, heir of House Eisen, which has kept the Great Clock for generations. Proud, sharp, and carrying something she tells no one.
characters.register: お嬢様語 (noble young lady): わたくし, 〜ですわ/〜ですの/〜かしら, 〜ませ, refined keigo. Pure fiction-speak that instantly signals wealth and pride.

characters.name: ヴァルター
characters.desc: Count Walter Eisen, Viola's father and Keeper of the Great Clock. Cold, exacting, and devoted above all to the family name.
characters.register: Aristocratic patriarch: 私, plain imperatives and 〜なさい to his daughter, 〜ねばならん / 〜ならん, smooth keigo to peers. Authority in every sentence.

characters.name: オズ
characters.desc: Sera's grandfather. Forty years a clockmaker in the lower ring. Few words, foul mouth, very good hands.
characters.register: Gruff old craftsman: 〜ねえ for 〜ない, 〜やがる, 〜だぞ, bare imperatives (行け). Downtown-Tokyo old-man flavour.

characters.name: エリス
characters.desc: Sera's mother. A Great Clock engineer employed by House Eisen, who vanished ten years ago and left her daughter a watch that would not run.
characters.register: Warm, plain feminine speech: 〜のね, 〜の, ごめんなさい, 〜ないで. Soft standard speech — the voice of a mother talking to her child.

characters.name: レーゲン
characters.desc: Mechanics instructor. Thin, greying, permanently sleepy-eyed — and nobody has ever dozed off in his class.
characters.register: Standard polite teacher speech: です/ます, 〜てください. The neutral baseline every other register departs from.

characters.name: グレゴール
characters.desc: Rector of the Royal Vern Academy, descendant of its founder. White-bearded, gentle, adored by students.
characters.register: Benevolent elder: soft polite 〜ですよ/〜でしょう to the young, 諸君 and clipped 〜ん (限らん) among peers. The grandfatherly voice of authority.

characters.name: 灰の男
characters.desc: A man in a grey coat and grey mask. Watches from high places.
characters.register: Cold formal villain style: 〜のだ/〜である, archaic negatives (〜ぬ). The voice of proclamations and masterminds.

books.title: 星割りの塔
books.tagline: 一晩で現れた黒い塔から、リナの物語が始まる。
books.taglineEn: A black tower appears overnight, and Rina's story begins.

characters.name: リナ
characters.desc: 17, a map-maker's apprentice from Rieden village. Curious to a fault.
characters.register: Casual feminine-neutral speech: あたし, plain forms, sentence-final の/よ/ね, casual contractions (〜てる, 〜なきゃ).

characters.name: ガルドヴァン
characters.desc: The old mage who lives in the tower. Knows why it moved.
characters.register: Classic sage role language (博士語): わし for I, じゃ for だ, 〜ておる for 〜ている, 〜ねばならぬ, 〜まい, sentence-final のう/かの. Heard in fiction constantly, never in real life.

characters.name: ドレック
characters.desc: A mercenary hired for the road to the capital. Louder than he is dangerous.
characters.register: Rough masculine speech: 俺, だぜ/だろ, contractions 〜ちまう/〜じゃねえか, dropped politeness everywhere. The register of action heroes and street toughs.

characters.name: エステル
characters.desc: Second princess of the realm. Sharp behind the etiquette.
characters.register: Court keigo: 〜でございます, いらっしゃる/おっしゃる, humble いたす/おる, 〜ませ. The register of palaces, hotels, and formal business.

chapters.titleEn: The Tower Not on Any Map

chapters.titleEn: The Old Man of the Tower
